difficulty_reason: T = Z' x_Z Spec(k) is nonempty (points-cartesian) and T -> Spec(k) is a monomorphism, hence T = Spec(k) (monomorphism-toward-field); so Spec(k) -> Z factors through Z'; every object of Z over any scheme is fppf-locally a pullback of the image object xi, hence also of its lift xi'; descent of objects gives essential surjectivity, with full faithfulness from monomorphism.
